text:
alicia: Heads-up — noticed a ~45% month-over-month jump in untagged GPU spend in us-west1 this billing cycle. Breakout shows mostly p3 and a100 instances. Anyone else see this?

ben: saw spike in budget dashboard, didn't dig yet. Do you have the query?

alicia: pasting the quick BQ query I used:  
```sql
SELECT labels, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_month = "2026-02"
  AND resource.type LIKE "%gpu%"
GROUP BY labels
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

charu: looks like many rows have label "team": null vs "team": "research". Our infra tagging policy enforces "team" but the terraform module we pushed last quarter uses "owner". Mismatch = untagged resources.

maria: can we backfill labels via asset inventory? For VMs we can set labels now but GCP billing uses labels at usage time — so retro attribution probably not possible.

ben: Right — we can't change historical billing. We can fix future attribution and produce an internal reclassification for chargeback.

alicia: also — we discovered a Dedicated pool allocation intended for east-region got provisioned in us-west by the autoscaler, so committed discounts are being consumed under the wrong cost center. Need to map committed credits to cost_center tags.

cost-ops: FYI we allocate committed discounts at the billing account and ledger level. We do have a ledger mapping table; if infra provides instance IDs or pool IDs we can run the nightly attribution to reassign internally. For formal changes we may need a provider support case.

charu: proposal: 
1) run a tag-sweep to detect nonconforming labels and auto-create owner tickets (automation).
2) add a pre-apply terraform policy that enforces required labels and fails CI if missing.
3) reassign Dedicated pool metadata/tags + update provisioning routing so provisioners pick region by cost_center.
4) produce internal adjusted invoice for Feb with reclassification for chargeback.

maria: I'll open an ENG ticket and add owners. Ben — can you paste a script to dump instance IDs?

ben: quick commands I used: 
```bash
# GCP: list instances missing team label
gcloud compute instances list --filter="labels.team:(null)" --format="table(name,zone,labels)"

# AWS: list instances with missing team tag
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:team,Values=null" --query "Reservations[].Instances[].[InstanceId,Placement.AvailabilityZone,Tags]"
```

infra-bot: alert: automated tag-sweep found 127 resources missing "team" or "cost_center" labels in us-west1. Report: https://docs.redwood/infra/tag-sweep-report/1769123499 :eyes: 

alicia: ok assigning hotfix — will add the pre-apply policy to prod terraform module this afternoon and run remediation. tagging + chargeback sheet here: https://docs.redwood/sheets/internal-chargeback/labels-feb-2026

maria: cost-ops, can you confirm whether committed credits can be reassigned or if we must shift workloads? :thinking:

cost-ops: provider commitments are regional. Options: reallocate Dedicated capacity internally (we can do that), or open a provider case to request re-assigning billing attachment. I'll start a case and loop in finance.

ben: timeline: hotfix + terraform check today, tag-sweep remediation in next 48h, internal adjusted invoice by EOW. :thumbsup:

alicia: thanks team :pray: I'll follow up with the owners list once sweep completes.
